pr_title: Checkbox state is taken into account when editing properties, undoing/redoing
pr_body:
Fixes #55455.

Previously, if the checkbox existed, it will be checked while the properties are overridden. But undo_redo does not record the state of the checkbox, so it may lead to strange behavior.

`autoclear` in `EditorInspector` seems to have the same effect as `checkable` in `EditorProperty` there, I'm not sure if there are other effects.

It seems to me that `Variant::is_null` means the type is `Variant::NIL` or the object is `nullptr`. 
Judging from the results of `Variant::is_null`, it may be more appropriate to change the name to `Variant::is_not_object` (`nullptr` is not object, just means Object Type).


`nullptr` means the **empty set** of the whole `Object` set, `Variant::NIL` means the **empty set** of the whole `Variant` set.

![relationship](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30386067/165091773-eafeeb0d-c86d-46af-bd94-1373f61c4d99.png)

pr_comments: When changing the override property for multiple nodes, the property is not checked properly.

> When changing the override property for multiple nodes, the property is not checked properly.

May need to rely on `EditorInspector::refresh` to refresh dynamically, so what is the name of `EditorInspector::refresh` changed？`update`?
@Rindbee It has nothing to do with `EditorInspector::refresh` I think. The error you see exists before your change.

Well, I had took the wrong way. 
The property `checked` is only in `EditorProperty` and can be inferred from the value, so it might be more appropriate to automatically modify it when the value is changed. Just like the revert icon state. 
So it is appropriate to put its modification logic into `EditorProperty::update_revert_and_pin_status` (Renamed to `update_property_status` might be more appropriate now), `UndoRedo` does not have to record the `CheckBox` state, only record the value changing.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e9e2aaf8123bbaf03621a869f21433fff4af5144/editor/editor_inspector.cpp#L3544-L3554

It may be better to put `E->update_cache(); ` before `E->update_revert_and_pin_status();`, so the property status can be updated directly with the cached value.

Now, everything works as expected, besides the following two points:
1. Because the check status is now determined according to the property value, and `EditorPropertyRevert::get_property_revert_value` returns null,  so the checkbox will be unchecked when the revert icon is clicked. `[Object:null]` eventually becomes `null` during the transfer. This also causes the properties of Object-derived types can't be checked when they are unchecked.
2. After operating the properties of multiple nodes, then select only a few of these nodes and view the edited properties in the Inspector, and then perform the undo operation: the refresh interval of the properties displayed in the Inspector is related to `docks/property_editor/auto_refresh_interval`.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30386067/165468873-66a8ccb1-92a0-4eeb-a1af-3d4309122939.mp4
This patch can be split into several independent patches, that might be better.

issue_context.title: Theme override checkbox is oblivious to undo
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.4 / 4.0 03cfdf8

### System information

W10

### Issue description

The checkbox next to theme override properties takes effect when toggled, but the toggle isn't stored in the undo history in any way. When you add e.g. a color override, you can undo it, but the checkbox will still be pressed (until you re-select node). When you uncheck the checkbox to clear override, you won't be able to undo it.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add e.g. Label
2. Add override to `font_color` theme property
3. Undo it
4. Redo
5. Uncheck the checkbox
6. Undo / redo
7. Weird things will happen

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: @Calinou This also applies to master; I edited the version to be more clear.

Seems better than before, but it's still not fixed yet:
![godot windows tools x86_64_CNAZW7gJQ0](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/190625549-2e1b54ac-2571-4c31-ab17-8fb41c6e2427.gif)
You can't undo to pre-checkbox state.

review_comments:
I think this check should be kept at your added code.

Before, this function won't touch check state if not `autoclear`. After, it always updates the check state if undoable, and never updates when not-undoable.

It's true that currently in the editor, a `EditorInspector` is either set to not use undo, or set to not use autoclear, so it does not seem to cause any trouble. But that fact is outside the scope of this class.

From the display point of view, it is OK to record the state of the checkbox only once(the one currently displayed). The main thing is to determine whether the undo_redoes used in `EditorInspector` and `MultiNodeEdit::_set_impl` are the same, and whether it is feasible to split the whole operation into different classes.
Great, my guess was right, and `UndoRedo::MERGE_ALL` would solve the problem.
